client: Coastline Hardware
client_industry: wholesale
start: 2021-10
end: 2021-12
engagement: fixed
stack:

metrics:

text: Mina built a workbook that made our weekly inventory reconciliation much easier to manage, and the results were immediate. We found $86k in stock variance, and what used to take 6 hours now takes about 20 minutes. Solid work, practical solution, and exactly what we needed.
